items.title: Apple Silicon 与 macOS 虚拟机：借助 Llama.cpp 实现 11-16 倍的 LLM 推理加速
items.summary: Cua团队在Apple Silicon的macOS虚拟机中构建了一个进程级Metal能力垫片，将虚拟GPU的Apple家族提升至9（1009）并将线程组内存从32KB提升至64KB，使llama.cpp能选用更新的SIMD和bfloat16路径。在M1 Ultra搭配llama.cpp b10167的测试中，TinyLlama 1.1B的提示词处理速度提升11.08倍、token生成速度提升16.36倍，达到裸机性能的98%；Gemma 4 12B QAT Q4_0则分别提升7.20倍和14.54倍，达到
items.summary_en: A process-scoped Metal capability shim intercepts GPU feature queries inside macOS virtual machines, raising reported Metal family to 9 and threadgroup memory to 64 KB so llama.cpp selects faster GPU kernels. On an M1 Ultra, this boosted TinyLlama 1.1B inference by 11.08× on prompt processing and 16.36× on token generation, and Gemma 4 12B by 7.20× and 14.54× respectively, reaching up to 99.59% of bare-metal prompt speed and 94.82% of bare-metal generation speed. The solution works within Apple's existing Virtualization.framework paravirtualized GPU path without requiring physical GPU passthrough or kernel modifications.

items.title: 谷歌创始人布林紧急接管Gemini团队，但“3.5 Pro已被取消”
items.summary: 谷歌Gemini 3.5 Pro旗舰模型已被取消，目前仅推出强调速度的Flash系列，在复杂推理和编程任务上落后于Claude、GPT等竞品。创始人谢尔盖·布林紧急重回Gemini战略核心，深度参与AI方向决策。与此同时，谷歌面临严重算力内耗，2026年Q3至2027年Q4期间超过20%的TPU出货量将直接供应给竞争对手Anthropic。
items.summary_en: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has re-entered the Gemini team amid internal turmoil, following the apparent cancellation of the Gemini 3.5 Pro flagship model, which was previously promised at Google I/O 2025 but never materialized. items.title: Every baby app wanted a subscription or showed me ads while logging a 3am feed so I built my own. Free, local-first, open source.
items.summary: 开发者开发了一款名为Numa Baby的开源婴儿追踪应用，采用MIT许可证开源，使用Claude Code开发，基于PWA技术实现离线可用，运行成本为零（托管于Cloudflare免费层）。该应用支持一键记录喂养、换尿布和睡眠，能学习宝宝节奏预测下次喂养时间，并提供链接至AAP/WHO/NHS的权威育儿信息，所有数据本地存储，无账号、无云端、无广告。
items.summary_en: The author built Numа, a free open-source baby tracking app after finding existing options plagued by subscriptions and intrusive ads. Key features include one-tap logging for feeds, diapers, and sleep; AI-powered rhythm prediction; WHO/AAP-sourced growth percentiles; and a fully local-first architecture with zero cloud storage or data collection. Built as a PWA hosted on Cloudflare's free tier and MIT-licensed, the project was developed using Claude Code.

items.title: 将 GitHub Copilot 置于中间人（MitM）代理之后后，我学到了什么
items.summary: 作者将 GitHub Copilot 置于 mitmproxy 中间人代理之后，通过拦截 VS Code 网络流量分析其内部运作机制。研究发现 Copilot 启动时会执行标准 OAuth 认证流程，通过 `/models` 和 `/agents/swe/models` 端点发现可用模型与 SWE 智能体能力，并在每次请求前通过 `/models/session/intent` 端点基于意图分类（代码生成、调试、推理等）路由到对应模型。文章还详细给出了在 macOS 上安装 mitmproxy、配置 VS Code 代理设置及处理过期扩展宿主进程的具体操作步骤。
items.summary_en: The author used mitmproxy to intercept and analyze network traffic from VS Code and GitHub Copilot, revealing Copilot's internal request patterns. Key findings include an OAuth-based authentication flow, model discovery endpoints (`/models` and `/agents/swe/models`), and an intent-classification router at `/models/session/intent` that routes prompts to appropriate models based on categories like code generation, debugging, reasoning, and tool use. The guide also covers troubleshooting stale extension host processes in Electron-based apps and configuring VS Code proxy settings (`http.proxy`, `http.proxyStrictSSL`, `http.proxySupport`).

items.title: ChatGPT 与 Gemini 双双突破 10 亿用户
items.summary: ChatGPT 于 6 月突破 10 亿用户（7 月周活达 10 亿），OpenAI 于 8 月 6 日才正式宣布。Gemini 作为谷歌史上增长最快的产品，从 2 月 7.5 亿月活快速攀升至上周 10 亿，其中 iOS 已超 1 亿活跃用户。两者用户规模接近，但 ChatGPT 的增长已从早期爆发转为放缓，AI 竞赛进入存量争夺阶段。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT and Google's Gemini have both surpassed 100 million users, marking a major milestone in the AI competition. OpenAI's ChatGPT crossed the threshold in June with weekly active users hitting 1 billion by July, though its growth has slowed from 900 million weekly users in February. Gemini, Google's fastest-growing product and its 14th to reach 1 billion users, jumped from 750 million monthly active users in February to over 1 billion by late July, with more than 100 million users on iOS alone. While ChatGPT remains the larger and more recognized platform, Gemini is growing faster, signaling that OpenAI's once-dominant lead has significantly narrowed.

items.title: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent
items.summary: Prime Agent 是一款开源的递归语言模型（RLM）编码代理，通过 /refine 机制对补充提示、记忆和技能描述进行小幅度、基于证据的本地化更新以实现自我改进。其内置的子代理可通过 rlm(...) 函数调用并行或异步执行任务，配合自动压缩、心跳、计划及持久目标等功能保障长时工作的连续性。部署可通过命令一键完成，并支持通过 /login 切换订阅或 API Key 提供商，以及使用 prime-agent attach 和 --resume 等命令重新连接或恢复后台守护进程中的会话。

items.title: 3 AI Prompts for Google Ads
items.summary: 本文提供了3个用于Google Ads的AI Prompt：第一个Prompt通过对比竞品网站，生成不超过30字符的标题和不超过90字符的描述，每个主题至少产出10条文案；第二个Prompt围绕指定关键词生成落地页内容，正文字数不超过200词，并生成三个版本分别强调紧迫感、用户收益和安抚语气；第三个Prompt根据网站定义目标受众，创建基于兴趣和搜索行为的两个自定义细分，并匹配对应的in-market audiences和affinity categories。

items.title: H3-metal – Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon
items.summary: H3-metal 是面向 Apple Silicon 的原生 MiniMax-H3 推理项目，已在 M3 Max 和 M5 Max 上实现 Prompt-to-video/audio、首尾帧条件控制及有序 Ref2VA 参考的端到端支持。通过 --layers 45、--steps 20、--reuse 2 等参数可在统一内存与生成速度间取得平衡，--show 功能支持在 Kitty/iTerm2 等终端中实时预览去噪过程。该项目以增量方式逐步构建，优先保证确定性元数据与 Metal 块级性能优化。
items.summary_en: H3-metal enables native MiniMax-H3 text-to-video inference on Apple Silicon (M3 Max, M5 Max) via Metal, supporting prompt-to-video/audio, first/last-frame conditioning, and ordered Ref2VA image references. It provides a CLI with an interactive session that keeps BF16 prompt conditioning, prepared DiT, and video decoder resident in memory for fast repeated generation. Performance is tunable through parameters like `--steps` (denoising passes), `--layers` (transformer blocks, default 45/50), and `--reuse` (velocity extrapolation), with a preview mode adding ~10 GiB residency for frame display.

items.title: Skilly - free AI course generator for learning any desktop software
items.summary: Skilly是一款免费的AI学习工具，可将“用Excel构建财务模型”或“在Blender中制作作品集渲染图”等具体目标自动转化为六课时的学习计划。用户无需注册即可查看完整预览，确认有用后可将Markdown格式的文件发送至邮箱，并在Skilly Mac应用中配合语音和屏幕指引进行操作。由于不同软件版本存在差异，生成的计划会附带参考资料并建议用户自行核实版本相关说明。

items.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
items.summary: Anthropic确认将对Claude等AI生成文本添加隐形水印，以遵守已于8月2日生效的欧盟《AI法案》透明度代码。所有8月2日后发布的模型将默认启用水印技术，文件则采用C2PA开放标准，水印可随文本复制粘贴和一定编辑操作保留，并覆盖Claude平台API、Claude Code、Claude Cowork、Claude Tag等产品。除Anthropic外，Google、Meta、Microsoft、OpenAI、Black Forest Labs和Synthesia等公司也已承诺遵守欧盟代码，AI音乐平台Suno和Newsletter服务Substack同样开始标记AI生成内容。

harveyai/harvey-labs
items.summary: Harvey Labs（Legal Agent Benchmark）是由Harvey AI发布的开源基准测试项目（v1.0），旨在评估LLM代理在真实法律环境中的工作能力。该项目包含任务数据集和执行框架两部分，前者收录了代理指令、法律文档和评分标准，后者用于运行和评估代理表现。项目提供了端到端的M&A数据室作业示例，涵盖任务检查、代理执行、评分及报告对比等完整流程。
items.summary_en: Harvey LAB is an open-source benchmark released by Harvey AI in 2026 to evaluate LLM agents on realistic legal work, including M&A data-room assignments. It combines a task dataset (with agent instructions, documents, and rubrics) and an execution harness for running and scoring agents using all-pass rubric scoring and LLM judge behavior. The project is available at github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs/tree/v1.0.
